source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
Check the type of reports the company is legally required to submit.
3. Prepare a list of the type of documents you expect to receive in the report. 
4. Add the missing regulations in the list. 
5. Ask your colleagues about other possibly relevant information they had found for this company. 
6. Update the list.
7. Send out a request for all relevant reporting documents.
8. Do not settle for vague promises. Insist on receiving non-abbreviated reports.
9. Make it a priority to get the required records.
10. If it is a large company, it may send the report in several formats. 
11. Check if there are any important appendices along with the report summary.

  ### If the report is incomplete
- Reach out to the regulatory officers to explain your metrics and calculation methods.
